--- gql_braced_ambiguity_array_paren.sql
-- Regression: ARRAY(...) SQL subquery must still parse after ARRAY { gql } support.
ARRAY(SELECT 1)
--- AST
&ast.ArraySubQuery{
  Array:  85,
  Rparen: 99,
  Query:  &ast.Select{
    Select:  91,
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.ExprSelectItem{
        Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
          ValuePos: 98,
          ValueEnd: 99,
          Base:     10,
          Value:    "1",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
ARRAY(SELECT 1)
